test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. **

Something which brings bad luck
solution: The correct answer is '**Jinxed**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Jinxed**'. • It means** 'bring bad luck to; cast an evil spell on'. **(दुर्भाग्य लाना) • *Example: The play is **jinxed**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Jinxed.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Devilish**: like or appropriate to a devil in evil and cruelty. (बुराई और क्रूरता में एक शैतान की तरह या उपयुक्त) • **Monstrous**: that people think is shocking and unacceptable because it is morally wrong or unfair. [लोगों को स्‍तब्‍ध कर देने वाला और अस्‍वीकार्य (अनैतिक या अनुचित होने के कारण), नितांत असंगत] • **Wicked**: morally bad; evil. (चरित्रहीन, भ्रष्‍ट; बुरा, दुष्‍ट, पापी) 34:Tdc7, The correct answer is **'doesn't listen'.**
